jobs.description: ROS 2 and applied AI for robots: object detection and natural spoken interaction with people.
highlights: Own the ROS 2 platform behind Manara, an in-production service robot deployed at the Two Holy Mosques: autonomous navigation, motor control, and a self-docking/charging system rewritten from scratch.
Lead developer of the fleet's core ROS 2 package (500+ commits): bringup, layered configuration and setup tooling for 4 robots across 3 hardware models.
Tuned Nav2 (MPPI controller) and AMCL on production robots, and built a heading-fusion node that fuses wheel odometry with gyro data.
Introduced per-package semantic versioning and monthly fleet releases, shipped as Debian packages through GitHub Actions.
Shipped a person-following feature across robot, web bridge and follower packages, and made twist_mux plus a two-level e-stop the single path to the wheels.
Build and integrate applied-AI capabilities on the robots, including object recognition and voice-based interaction with people.
